title: Top-level null cost shadows the usage cost

request.goal: Using only the source, state exactly what _cost_from_response returns for the response {"artifact": {}, "api_equivalent_cost_usd": null, "usage": {"api_equivalent_cost_usd": 0.31}} (JSON null is Python None).

code.title: scripts/frontier_providers.py excerpt

pass: It returns None. The top-level key is present (its value is None), so _cost_from_usage gets {"api_equivalent_cost_usd": None} and the 0.31 in usage is never consulted.
None; the usage value is ignored because the top-level key exists.
